writing.exampleCaption: Borrowing lets dbg! inspect the Vec without consuming it.
writing.explanation: The {:?} formatter uses the Debug trait. dbg! prints the expression, source location, and value to stderr, then returns the value unchanged. Borrow with dbg!(&value) when you want to inspect an owned value without moving it. Remove noisy probes or replace them with deliberate logging before shipping.
writing.feedback: Pass a shared reference so the debug probe does not take ownership.
